name: Then vs Now ("Christmas last year.. → Vs.. → Christmas this year")
status: PROVEN on decor (FB): 7 winners 64.5K-152.9K across Merry Glow + Merry Glows. Retro-year '🤮' version is the external mega-winner (5.5M, 3.2M, 2.9M, 1.0M).
summary: Open on a disaster 'then' scene with NO product (family + dog in a festive room; smoke, fire, a ladder fall), switch to 'Vs..' on the first body cut, show the box → install → activation, and switch to 'Christmas this year' exactly on the light-up cut.
why: 5 of the top 6 Merry Glow reels (70-153K) and both Merry Glows winners (67.7K, 64.5K) are then-vs-now (PLAYBOOK §2.1).
The identical fire-pit file did 40.3K on IG and 67.7K on FB (cross-platform carry).
External: merryglow.official 'Christmas Decor In 1950🤮' 5.5M (TikTok mirror 3.2M / 34.2K shares), '1965' 2.9M, tryglowmas '1995🤮' 1.0M, glowfall '1649' 520K (external §2, §3b).
Within decor pages retention tracks views (avg watch ρ=0.85) and more people in the opening frame → higher 3-s rate (hooks REPORT §1.6).

rules: 'Vs..' switches on at the first body cut (2.8-4.3 s) and holds until the payoff.
'Christmas this year' switches on EXACTLY on the first LIT/FAMILY cut (8.600-11.233 s).
BOX/UNBOX ≤2.0 s with motion inside; prep total ≤4.5 s (body REPORT §3). Or put the box in the hook (MG 98K moved drop-off to 0:11).
LIT at 66-74%, then a 3-shot escalating payoff, 1.0-1.4 s each, locked camera.

text.style: Card sequence, house placement. Each card change happens only on a cut.

Static camera, real chaos, no product visible. Natural sound only: sparks, gasps, a dog barking. No music, no text.
